name: contradiction_vs_consistency_eval
description: Held-out binary ASNE contrast for matching versus conflicting scene information.

items.text: A person checks a room number in an email and sees the same number printed beside the door.
Someone scans a receipt and sees the item code match the code on the box.
A person reads the platform board and sees the route number shown on the paper ticket.
A person checks a room number in an email while the door beside them shows another number.
Someone scans a receipt and sees an item code that differs from the code on the box.
A person reads the platform board while the paper ticket shows another route number.
